instructions: Ployz runs Projects with Environments of Services on your servers. Names, not ids. Every result says where it ran as at. A refusal has code, message, field, expected, example, retry (a complete call), writes (none, committed or unknown) and next (the calls to make now). When writes is unknown, make the next call before anything else. Most writes are Staged: review shows them, discard undoes them, deploy ships them. Not here: branches, tokens, servers added, exec, live logs, up; the member does those in the terminal. project and environment default to the place you are in. request_key: any 8 to 64 letters, digits, - or _; send the same key again after a lost reply and you get the same run, never a second one. wait_seconds: wait up to that long (max 300) for the outcome; 0 returns once accepted. Reads say when they were seen; a server that did not answer is listed, never guessed. Logs never show a secret; do not ask a tool for one. Servers and their logs need Ployz Cloud.

tools.description: Change one Service's Settings and variables in one step. set changes the Settings it names and keeps the rest; env inside set sets the variables it names. unset returns Settings to their default, deletes variables (env.KEY), or unmounts (mounts.VOLUME, configs.CONFIG). rename_env renames variables and keeps their values, secret or not. Domains are not Settings: use domain_add, domain_update, domain_remove. Most changes are Staged: Review lists them, Discard undoes them, so do not ask the member to confirm. template, autoDeploy, waitForCi, watchPaths and preferredBuilder take effect at once and Discard does not undo them; the result lists them under immediate. Secrets and registry credentials cannot be set here: the member sets them in the dashboard or terminal. Never asks a human to approve.

rename_env.description: Variables to rename, old name to new name. The value moves with it; a secret stays sealed.

set.description: A Service's Settings, in the shape service_inspect returns as values.

autoDeploy.description: Deploy the Environment's Saved State when its branch gets a new commit. Takes effect at once.
autoDeploy.title: Auto-deploy

branch.description: The branch the Service builds. Ployz checks it exists.
branch.title: Branch

buildCommand.description: Overrides Railpack's build command. Unset keeps detection; Dockerfiles ignore it.
buildCommand.title: Build command

buildMethod.description: How the image is built: Railpack detects it, or a Dockerfile.
buildMethod.title: Build method

configs.description: Where the Service mounts each Config, by Config name, each at SERVICE.configs.CONFIG. Add the Config first. Unset unmounts it: the Config and its files stay.

^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$.description: The absolute directory the Config's files appear in, read-only, in the Service's containers, with no `.` or `..` segment, empty segment or trailing `/`. Unset unmounts it: the Config and its files stay.
^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$.title: Mount directory

configs.title: Config mounts

cpuLimit.description: Most vCPUs each replica may use. Unset means no limit.
cpuLimit.title: CPU limit

dockerfilePath.description: The Dockerfile to build, relative to the root directory. Unset means Dockerfile.
dockerfilePath.title: Dockerfile path

env.description: Environment variables by name, each at SERVICE.env.KEY. A patch sets the ones it names and keeps the rest; unset deletes one.

^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$.description: An environment variable. Text may reference variables: ${{ KEY }} for this Service's, ${{ service.KEY }} for another's; $${{ is a literal ${{. A secret reads as {"secret": true}, or {"secret": false} until it has a value, and sending that back keeps it. {"value": …, "exported": true} marks one other Services are meant to reference.
^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]{0,127}$.title: Variable

env.title: Variables

healthcheck.description: A check a new replica must pass before it takes traffic: an HTTP path on the container PORT or a shell command, and how many seconds it may take (default 300). Text sets the path. Unset turns it off, along with the image's own check.
healthcheck.title: Healthcheck

image.description: The container image each replica runs.
image.title: Container image

maxRetries.description: How often an on-failure restart policy restarts a replica.
maxRetries.title: Max retries

memLimit.description: Most memory each replica may use. A number is GB; a string takes a unit. Unset means no limit.
memLimit.title: Memory limit

mounts.description: Where the Service mounts each Volume, by Volume name, each at SERVICE.mounts.VOLUME. Create the Volume first. Unset detaches it: the Volume and its data stay.

^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$.description: The absolute path the Volume is mounted at in the Service's containers. Unset detaches it: the Volume and its data stay.
^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$.title: Mount path

mounts.title: Mounts

preDeployCommand.description: Runs once in a new replica before a Deploy starts the Service.
preDeployCommand.title: Pre-deploy command

preferredBuilder.description: Who builds this Service first: "github" for GitHub Actions, or a Server's Machine ID; then the Organization's Build Order, without it. Unset follows the Build Order. Applies to the next build.
preferredBuilder.title: Preferred Builder

privateDns.description: The name other Services in the Environment reach it at, as NAME.internal. Renaming the Service keeps it. Unset returns it to the Service's name.
privateDns.title: Private DNS

replicas.description: How many copies of the Service run.
replicas.title: Replicas

repository.description: The GitHub repository the Service builds, as owner/name. Ployz checks the Organization can read it; a change keeps the branch if the new repository has it, else uses its default branch.
repository.title: Repository

rootDir.description: The repository directory the build starts in. Unset means the repository root.
rootDir.title: Root directory

startCommand.description: Overrides the image's command. Unset runs the image's own.
startCommand.title: Start command

template.description: The Service Template it was created from, and its version. It changes nothing that runs. Unset forgets it.
template.title: Template

waitForCi.description: Hold an auto-deploy until every GitHub check suite of the commit passes. Takes effect at once.
waitForCi.title: Wait for CI

watchPaths.description: Gitignore-style patterns of repository paths a push must change to auto-deploy; the last matching pattern wins and ! excludes. Empty means any change. Takes effect at once.
watchPaths.title: Watch paths

unset.description: Settings to return to default, variables to delete (env.KEY), mounts to remove (mounts.VOLUME, configs.CONFIG).
